items.title: Isidore Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: The name 'Paul' appears only in the interviewer's questions ('It was made of wood, Paul', 'I'd come after Paul', 'How many brothers did you have with Paul'). The interviewee never mentions Paul, nor does he respond to questions about a specific person named Paul in a way that establishes a personal

ctx.x: Mm-mm. If it was wood, would it be a string instrument, like a cello, maybe?
It was wood? Yeah, yeah. It was a wood instrument. It was made of wood, Paul.
Same kind of wood as a clarinet.
